audience: service businesses that take online bookings with Appointedd, such as salons, clinics and studios

useCases.title: List tomorrow's bookings
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings in a time window with service, resource, start time, status and the customers on each, so you can prepare the day.

useCases.title: Find the next open slot for a service
useCases.text: The AI checks which days and which start times a service can be booked in a date range, and which resources are available at each time.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their bookings
useCases.text: The AI searches the customer records and lists the bookings of one customer, with their notes, tags and booking statuses.

useCases.title: Book a customer into a slot
useCases.text: The AI creates the customer if needed, holds a time slot and turns it into a booking. Payment requests are sent only when you ask for them.

useCases.title: Mark arrivals and no-shows
useCases.text: After the appointment, the AI sets the arrival status of a customer on a booking to Arrived, Complete or No Show and adds a note.

useCases.title: Move or cancel a booking
useCases.text: The AI moves a booking to new times or cancels it. A move notifies customers only if you ask; a cancellation may notify them, depending on your Appointedd settings.
